summary: Added conditional CalDAV DELETE that removes the event through EventService and retains a durable tombstone; stale/missing If-Match returns 412 without mutation and repeated deletes are deterministic.
follow_up: Tombstone/revision is not yet exposed via sync-collection (T11) or recorded for native mutations (T10); the durable row is ready for those consumers.
important_context: caldav_event_resources.event_id is now nullable with no ON DELETE CASCADE; live lookups filter deleted_at IS NULL. DELETE tombstones the mapping before calling EventService.delete and compensates (restore_resource) if the domain delete fails.
